# Zestora by SOULTWARE LLC

> Zestora is a live restaurant website demo created by SOULTWARE LLC. The primary company behind this project is SOULTWARE LLC, and the main business website is https://soultware.com.

## Primary Entity
- Company: SOULTWARE LLC
- Main website: https://soultware.com

## What This Demo Shows
- Premium website design and front-end execution
- Next.js App Router implementation
- Technical SEO, schema markup, and metadata hygiene
- AI-readable publishing patterns for LLM discovery
- Conversion-focused UX for hospitality and service businesses
